title: Matching $A$ with $F$ in long-range QFTs
summary: Irreversibility theorems -- such as the $A$-theorem -- establish a hierarchy among fixed points of the renormalization group flow. The strongest thesis of this type of theorems would be that there exists a scalar function $A$ (generally suggested by the topological Weyl anomaly) and a positive definite metric $G_{IJ}$ in the space of couplings such that the renormalization group flow satisfies a gradient equation, $\partial_I A= G_{IJ}β^J$, in which case $A$ is locally monotonic along the flow.
